**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Load brain + all its doctrines, then begin epic #313 (brain 1.1 roadmap) following the doctrine. Resolved to starting #330, which the epic body promotes as NEXT.

## Instructions
- User confirmed worktree-per-ticket is expected ("si hay alguno que necesita worktree propio lo puede hacer").
- Epic #313 cannot close until all associated tickets finish.

## Discoveries
- **Tracker correction**: epic #313 body names `feature/v2.0.0` as integration base, but `git rev-list --left-right --count origin/feature/v2.0.0...origin/main` = "0 32" — fully absorbed. Real tracker is `main`. Epic body declares itself source of truth, so it needs a doc PR to re-sync.
- `index.jsonl` is NOT append-only: `serializeIndex` (format.mjs:207-211) emits the whole file sorted by id; `rebuildIndex` (store.mjs:91) does one writeFileSync. Full rewrite → union can leave it UNSORTED, not just duplicated. The records' rationale does not transfer by analogy.
- NOTHING reads `index.jsonl` — every indexPath site in brain/scripts/** is a write via rebuildIndex; write-time dedup reads records/ (store.mjs:97-99).
- Index self-healing is BACKEND-ASYMMETRIC: plainfiles reindexes in share/pull/save/setup; engram.share() only when it appended (engram.mjs:315-318); engram.pull() never (engram.mjs:589-619). → filed as #361.
- phase-order gate (Rule A/C) forces a full 4-artifact SDD change dir for ANY impl code; `.gitattributes` is not in the allowlist (phase-order-check.mjs:34-43), so even a one-line fix needs the full cycle.
- memory-gate = repo-global session_summary EXISTENCE check over records/ (memory-presence.mjs), not a per-merge diff check.
- **UNDIAGNOSED**: `npm run memory:share` (engram backend) printed "Created chunk / Observations: 1965" but left `.memory/` byte-identical on BOTH worktree and main checkout — the session's new observation never became a record. The chunk is gitignored (.gitignore:84). MCP engram server vs `engram` CLI binary (1.17.0) may address different stores. Reported as an open question, deliberately NOT filed as an issue since the mechanism is undiagnosed.
- Tooling gotchas: `node --test <dir>` → MODULE_NOT_FOUND, repo verb is `npm test` (glob). `gh issue view` / `gh pr edit --add-label` fail with a Projects-classic GraphQL deprecation error; use `gh api repos/:owner/:repo/issues/<n>/labels`.

## Accomplished
- Loaded doctrines from AGENTS.md: agent-authorities (tiers), harness-contract, sdd-layout, workflow-governance, ADR index.
- #330 delivered end-to-end: worktree `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-330`, branch `fix/issue-330-fixmemory-memoryindexjsonl-has-no-merge`, base main.
- Full SDD artifact set + Tier-2 brain-draft (did NOT edit brain/core/** directly).
- Strict TDD: RED observed (pass 3/fail 1 on the repo tripwire) → GREEN (4/4).
- Test design applies the M10/#335 lesson: merge-mechanism test + NEGATIVE CONTROL (proves the attribute is causal) + REPO TRIPWIRE (prevents fixture-only green while production stays broken).
- Gates: repo:check ✓, npm test 2036/2036 ✓, change:verify ✓, memory-gate exit 0 ✓.
- **PR #360** open into main, type:bug, all 8 governance jobs pass. Commits ff4ee8a + 7038332.
- **Issue #361** filed for the backend asymmetry follow-up.

## Next Steps
- Human decides on PR #360 merge (agent must never approve/merge its own PR — Tier 3).
- Human promotes the brain-draft `memory-format-index-merge.md` into brain/core/methodology/memory-format.md (Tier 2). It also carries two doc-drift observations awaiting a ruling: memory-format.md:112 "the index is the dedup authority" reads more absolutely than store.mjs:97-99 supports; and "queries read through the index" has no implementation.
- Decide whether to diagnose the memory:share symptom above.
- Re-sync epic #313 body (feature/v2.0.0 → main) via doc PR.
- Next epic items per #313: Q5 (#358, marked URGENT, blocks #329), then T0 unblocking, M10 remaining phases. #358 has no status:approved yet.

## Relevant Files
- .gitattributes — added `/.memory/index.jsonl merge=union` + rationale comment
- brain/scripts/memory/lib/index-merge.integration.test.mjs — 4 tests (union, negative control, helper unit, repo tripwire)
- openspec/changes/issue-330-memory-index-merge-strategy/{proposal,spec,design,tasks}.md
- openspec/changes/issue-330-memory-index-merge-strategy/brain-drafts/memory-format-index-merge.md — Tier 2, awaits human promotion
- brain/scripts/memory/lib/format.mjs:207 / store.mjs:91,97 — the full-rewrite + dedup-source evidence
- brain/scripts/memory/backends/engram.mjs:315,589 — the asymmetry evidence for #361
